rule: Reviewer fix-cycle commits are sanctioned, never forbidden
description: Commit/push authority is now a structural POSITIVE GRANT ALLOWLIST in safety-rails.md's Commit Authority subsection (COMMIT-GRANT marker lines for orchestrator, local-reviewer, github-reviewer, delegated-implementer). set_check asserts the grant SET itself (equal mode + expected_counts) so a deleted grant, an unreviewed extra grant, or a duplicated grant all fail structurally instead of requiring one more literal clause pin per review pass. SCOPE BOUNDARY (deliberate, not an oversight): this assertion pins WHO HOLDS AUTHORITY AT ALL — the grant-set membership — and does NOT pin each grant's condition prose (entry points, standing vs delegation-scoped, push count, PR-mutation negatives). Pinning those dimensions one at a time is the literal-enumeration treadmill this fixture was rewritten to end: each added dimension leaves the next un-pinned dimension as the next review finding, so it never closes the class. The condition prose stays human-reviewed; the machine check owns the membership axis, where silent privilege expansion actually lives. The extraction is anchored on the COMMIT-GRANT MARKER rather than on a key charset so no authored grant line can be invisible to the check: any key that is not in expected_set surfaces as an extra and fails equal mode, including keys a charset-constrained capture would have skipped past (uppercase, digits, underscores). The `<` exclusion keeps the fixed-form template line (`COMMIT-GRANT <key>: ...`) out of the captured set; any other COMMIT-GRANT occurrence in the file is captured and must reconcile against the expected set. The remaining consumers entries are a bounded tail: the source-of-truth sentence, one citation-anchor pin per referencing agent doc, and the small set of step-mechanics clauses that are not expressible as a grant-set member.

source.pattern: Commit and push authority is a POSITIVE GRANT

consumers.pattern: EXPLICITLY forbids this agent from committing
Absence of commit-policy language is not a prohibition
This checkpoint is load-bearing for convergence
MUST SANCTION the reviewer's own fix-cycle checkpoint commits
MUST NOT forbid the reviewer committing
this prohibition is scoped to WAVE WORKER delegations
